race.title: 31 Days Free Racing TV At racingtv.com/freetrial Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: MR MCWHINNY had every chance of adding to his tally when departing at the last at Chepstow earlier this month so remains of firm interest. Chase debutant Painted Wolf may offer most resistance. MR MCWHINNY (IRE) PAINTED WOLF (IRE) HAWAII DU MESTIVEL (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Mr Mcwhinny (13/8), Hawaii Du Mestivel (11/4), Bahtiyar (4/1), Breezethroughlife (13/2), Painted Wolf (7/1)
